description: Deep Learning Foundations uses linear algebra (matrices, eigenvalues, the SVD) and multivariable calculus (gradients, the chain rule) throughout; the Neuromatch prerequisites page lists linear algebra, basic statistics and calculus. Probability is used at the level of expectations and the binomial distribution.
The tutorials and labs are in Python with array programming; the Neuromatch prerequisites page expects Python basics, NumPy and Matplotlib.
